common_contract.complete_episode_binding: Typed exact equality with the independently supplied input; never take expected_episode from the receipt.
common_contract.prefix_construction: Copy input independently and truncate only updates to the named length; preserve episode_id and all other fields.
common_contract.valid_episode_prefix_oracle: For a prefix of an authored VALID_EPISODE use its explicitly authored steps through that prefix. For an invalid full episode use historical_prefix_expectations; never infer a valid prefix from an error envelope.
common_contract.resource_semantics: LC-R06 has a valid bound episode but incomplete decisions; LC-R08 is an episode-level resource error without accepted steps.
common_contract.native_unavailable: UNMEASURED is never a passing observation contract.
